name: Doki Doki Exit Music: Redux
source:
Exit Music: Redux is a total rewrite and overhaul of the definitive 2018 DDLC mod, Exit Music.

Created by Wretched Team, this remake has improved the mod on every front, with a fresh take on the emotional, romantic & heart-wrenching story.

[Based from the [url=https://wretchedteam.com/projects/exit-music-redux/]official website[/url]]
translation:
《曲终人散——Exit Music: Redux》是对2018年经典《心跳文学部》模组《Exit Music》进行全面重写与改造的版本。

本次重制由Wretched Team制作，在各个方面都对原模组作出改进，以全新视角讲述这个情感丰沛、浪漫而令人心碎的故事。

[根据[url=https://wretchedteam.com/projects/exit-music-redux/]官方网站[/url]整理]
